supporting_observations.claim: The alerted periodic connections are attributable to C:\Program Files\LedgerLink\ledgerlinkupd.exe (PID 3128), which connected through the organization’s proxy to update.ledgerlink.com. The first observed connection is at 13:39:45 UTC.

The same process contacted update.ledgerlink.com at approximately five-minute intervals: 13:44:41, 13:49:51, 13:54:48, 13:59:35, 14:04:07, and 14:09:24 UTC. The proxy and endpoint network records support these connections.

The inventory identifies LedgerLink’s updater and update.ledgerlink.com checks about every five minutes as approved. The observed process, destination, and cadence are consistent with that documented behavior, so the available evidence supports a benign disposition for the alerted activity.
The updater process exited shortly after its last observed connection at 14:09:24 UTC.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied collection-status information reports winsec and Sysmon collection outages for WS-LWARD-01 from 13:30 to 14:00 UTC; that is not the alerted host. It reports those sensors, as well as proxy and Zeek collection, as available for the other hosts.

The LedgerLink connections are recorded as HTTPS proxy tunnels; these records establish the destination hostname and connection metadata, but do not show the tunnel’s application content or independently verify the remote server’s identity.
claims_not_established: The records do not establish the updater binary’s hash, signature, or integrity.
The records do not reveal what content, if any, was exchanged within the HTTPS tunnels.
The supplied records show the periodic updater activity beginning at 13:39:45 UTC; they do not show corresponding LedgerLink connections earlier in the alert’s stated 13:30–14:10 interval.
unrelated_findings: A Cisco AnyConnect vpnagent.exe process started on WS-MFISCHER-01, despite the inventory stating that the organization has no VPN. Review separately; the record shows process creation, not a VPN connection. (T246-00220, T246-00221)

WS-MFISCHER-01 made an SMB connection to FILE-SUN-01 that resulted in an ANONYMOUS LOGON. This is separate from the alerted HTTPS activity and merits independent review. (T246-00266, T246-00267, T246-00268, T246-00270)

At 13:24 UTC, the proxy recorded a GlobalProtect-branded request to updates.paloaltonetworks.com that failed with status 504. This predates the observed LedgerLink updater activity and should be handled separately. (T246-00045, T246-00046)
